skill.name: personwise-sop-process-training
skill.description: Creates grounded interactive SOP and process training from supplied documents. It uses PersonWise to build, review, publish, and manage source-backed digital-human courses.
skill.summary: Turn supplied SOP documents into grounded, interactive process training.
skill.author: personwiseai

security_audit.summary: The 142 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, defensive installer operations, and signed high-entropy metadata. The skill still presents high external-code risk because it installs an opaque CLI with native signature enforcement disabled, and it uploads selected documents to PersonWise.

remediation.issue: The workflow installs an opaque external executable, while native signature checks are disabled for current macOS and Windows artifacts.
remediation.suggestion: Publish auditable CLI source and reproducible builds. Sign and notarize every native artifact, enforce signature checks, and require informed installation confirmation.

remediation.issue: Selected SOP and policy documents are uploaded to the PersonWise service.
remediation.suggestion: Request explicit upload consent and identify the destination, data classes, retention policy, and deletion controls before transferring source files.

content.value_statement: SOP documents are often difficult to teach and verify consistently. This skill turns supplied procedures into grounded, interactive PersonWise courses with reviewed content.
actual_capabilities: Builds evidence-locked courses from supplied SOP, procedure, and policy documents.
Selects a coherent page count within the current PersonWise account limits.
Uploads user-selected sources and monitors their processing status.
Reviews outline and script checkpoints for support, consistency, and repetition.
Applies bounded factual corrections while preserving workflow state and revisions.
Publishes private or link-access courses and returns the matching course URL.
limitations: Requires the PersonWise CLI, a PersonWise account, browser OAuth, and available course credits.
Uploads selected source documents to the external PersonWise service.
Cannot provide regulatory certification or replace supervision and practical assessment.
Course accuracy depends on the completeness and correctness of supplied materials.

use_cases.title: Train Operations Teams
use_cases.description: Convert an approved operating procedure into structured training with ordered steps, exceptions, escalation guidance, and source version references.

use_cases.title: Roll Out Policy Changes
use_cases.description: Create updated training from revised policy files while keeping exact limits, controls, and document authority visible.

use_cases.title: Develop Internal Learning
use_cases.description: Build an interactive course that presents process content and answers learner questions from the supplied sources.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic SOP Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a private training course from the attached SOP. Teach the steps in order and identify the source document version.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a straightforward course from one approved procedure.

prompt_templates.title: Tailor Training to a Team
prompt_templates.prompt: Build process training from these files for new warehouse staff. Use six pages and include checks, exceptions, and escalation contacts.
prompt_templates.scenario: A manager has a defined audience and course length.

prompt_templates.title: Enforce Source-Only Grounding
prompt_templates.prompt: Create materials-only policy training from the selected documents. Preserve numbered steps and safety limits exactly. Add a short understanding check.
prompt_templates.scenario: A quality lead needs strict grounding and assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve Complex Source Updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Build link-access training from these SOP revisions. Identify conflicts, use the newest approved version, fit current page limits, and review every checkpoint.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user has multiple revisions, access requirements, and account constraints.

output_examples.input: Create a five-page private course from the attached lockout procedure.
output_examples.output: A five-page private course covering purpose, process flow, ordered steps, exceptions, and source version. The result includes a login-required course link.

output_examples.input: Train supervisors on the revised incident escalation policy and provide a shareable link.
output_examples.output: An interactive course grounded in the revised policy, with escalation triggers and contacts. Link access is enabled after successful review and publication.

best_practices: Provide the approved source document and its exact version.
State the learner group, desired outcome, page count, and access mode.
Review safety limits, numbered steps, and escalation details before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent procedures without authoritative source material.
Do not use the course as proof of certification, competence, or practical assessment.
Do not upload confidential files without authorization and an approved external-processing policy.

faq.question: What source materials can I use?
faq.answer: You can use selected SOP, procedure, process, and policy documents that you are authorized to upload.

faq.question: Does the skill write a new SOP?
faq.answer: No. It builds training from supplied material and does not create unsupported procedures from nothing.

faq.question: Can the course certify employees?
faq.answer: No. It cannot grant certification, confirm competence, or replace required supervision and practical assessment.

faq.question: What services are required?
faq.answer: The workflow requires the PersonWise CLI, a PersonWise account, browser OAuth, and available course credits.

faq.question: Are my documents uploaded?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected source documents are uploaded to PersonWise for course processing.

faq.question: Can the finished course be shared?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose private access or request link access. The skill returns the URL that matches the final access mode.
